title: Question 2.1: Train/Test Split - randomSplit Method
instruction: When learning, it's important to have some examples to study and some examples to test yourself on. This code divides the data into two groups.
reveal: This code randomly splits the dataset into two parts. The first part (80% of the data) becomes `trainData` - this is what the computer will use to learn patterns. The second part (20% of the data) becomes `testData` - this is what we'll use later to check if the computer learned correctly. The `RANDOM_SEED` ensures we get the same split every time we run the program, which makes results reproducible.
